_readme: Ground-truth TARGET task for golden UPDATE EVENTS that have no verbatim twin in the seeded state (the other update events are labeled automatically: the target is the seeded task with identical normalized text). Key = '<meeting number>|<update event text>'. 'targets' = task texts (from the golden expected outputs) that count as the correct task to match; [] means no suitable task exists yet at that point, so the item cannot be scored. 'also_accept' = extra tasks that are an equally valid target because the golden data itself holds near-duplicates for the same deliverable. Hand-labeled by Claude from each item's top-6 cosine neighbours (judgment, not ground truth from the dataset authors) - review and correct freely; an update event with neither a verbatim twin nor an entry here makes the eval stop rather than guess.
